g.text: Temporal controls across all 108 validation clips
Panel A: teal = true accuracy; amber = original target retained. Shuffle: 3 fixed seeds averaged within clip.
Panel B: median, IQR and 1.5 IQR whiskers; outliers omitted. Descriptive distributions, no confidence intervals.
